name: Candace Owens
role: American conservative commentator and podcaster; author of Blackout (2020); former Turning Point USA and Daily Wire host
summary: A commentator who rose as a critic of the Democratic Party and Black Lives Matter, founded the Blexit campaign, and opposes abortion and illegal immigration. Since 2023 she has been critical of US support for Israel and Ukraine, and has broken with Trump and the Daily Wire.

abortion-legal.rationale: Told the House Judiciary Committee in 2019 that she started out pro-choice, that 800 to 900 Black babies are aborted every day and that Black babies are 'separated from the womb of Black mothers', treating abortion as a harm to be ended.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Told the Daily Signal in 2018 that Democratic policies, 'the Great Society... government dependency... welfare', left Black Americans worse off and that racism is 'no longer an actual threat in this society for black Americans'.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: In Blackout she calls handouts 'a tool of the oppressor to keep you reliant upon the hand that feeds you' and says welfare keeps Black mothers single and reliant on the Democratic Party.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Said in March 2022 'I don't know what a woman is anymore' and 'you can throw on a wig and say actually I am a woman too'; her book calls the quest for transgender rights 'overcivilization'. No direct statement on legal recognition, so low.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Mixed: she has called the Holocaust 'an ethnic cleansing that almost took place' (Wikipedia) and called accounts of Mengele's experiments 'bizarre propaganda' and the Holocaust narrative one Zionists use to make Americans defend Israel (JNS); she did not state that the Holocaust did not occur.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Told the committee: 'All we preach is for free markets and capitalism as a means to lift the most people out of poverty. That is my belief.'

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Quoted as saying Israel was established by 'Frankists' who 'weren't Jews', that 'the Frankist cult, which masquerades behind Jews' still participates, 'Israel has a stranglehold on dialogue in America' and 'blame the Zionists'. These name Zionists/Frankists rather than an ethnic or religious minority per se, so mixed: 0, low.

more-religion-public.rationale: After becoming Catholic she said society falls apart 'when you don't aim toward those transcendentals' of beauty, truth and goodness, and that she wants everyone to be chanting 'Christ is king'.

nation-first.rationale: Told the House Judiciary Committee in 2019: 'I don't have any problems at all with the word nationalism... Globalism is what I don't want.'

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Argued structural racism is overstated, said liberals are 'the racists', and told Congress white supremacy/white nationalism talk is an 'election strategy' (2019); in a later hearing called white supremacy real but fringe.

traditional-family.rationale: Blackout advises 'Raise your children in a two-parent household' and argues Democratic policies undermined it; she also embraces traditional gender roles (Wikipedia).

notes:
Primary full texts (Blackout, testimony PDF, podcast transcripts, C-SPAN) were unreachable; evidence is quotes in news, a Prager letter, and Wikipedia. Mediaite and BizPac Review returned 403. Her COVID vaccine refusal (BlackAmericaWeb: 'I am not getting this vaccine, ever'), Ukraine and feminism remarks match no statement wording, so those stay null. Views changed: broke with Trump in 2025-26.

Later pass (claude-sonnet-5-5, 2026-11-14): brought to rules 7. Read her 42 turns of testimony in the House Judiciary hearing of 9 April 2019 (GovInfo) and the two CNN clips of it. Answered from it: abortion-legal now -2 medium from her own testimony (was -2 high from a Wikipedia summary), nation-first +2 medium, markets-allocate-better +2 medium. reduce-immigration and open-borders nulled: the Wikipedia-sourced wall/deportation claim has no original that I could find (the 2025 podcast 'build the wall' mention was a recollection, and the wall-fundraiser report may concern another person). Her remarks on welfare dependence, father absence and the Black family in the testimony agree with existing answers (traditional-family). Not used: 'restrict-hate-speech' ('we need to condemn all hate speech' is not a legal restriction), nationalism's Hitler exchange. Her post-2023 break with Trump and positions on Israel and Ukraine are not in this testimony and match no bank wording. Themes searched: abortion, borders, nationalism, welfare, free markets, race, speech, police, religion. The 2025 podcast transcript (p1, 9,100 words of hers) was read by theme (Israel, Palestinians, Zionism, Christians, abortion, immigration, the wall, feminism): her claims about Israeli influence and the planning of 7 October are conspiracy claims about a state and its lobby, not clearly 'a minority group secretly conspiring against the nation', so minority-conspiracy stays at its earlier answer; no jewish-state-israel or settler-state-colonial answer follows from 'no country has a right to commit a genocide'. Deeper push (same day): read her turns (about 69,000 words) in three 2025-26 interviews (Tucker Carlson, Shawn Ryan SRS #318, Part of the Problem #1325) by theme (religion and state, abortion, guns, taxes, welfare, immigration, monarchy, vaccines, marriage, drugs, unions, capitalism, democracy, free speech). They are about her break with the Trump circle, Israel, Epstein and the Kirk killing, so they settle only more-religion-public (+1 medium, from her conversion); her 'free markets and capitalism' mentions describe Kirk's organisation, not her own view, and are not used.
